content.content:
**⚠️ SCAM ALERT - DO NOT SEND ANY MONEY!**

This is a **common scam attempt**. Apple would **NEVER** ask you to pay additional money via phone call after a purchase, either for:
- VAT adjustments
- Fees
- Any other reason

**Red flags in this message:**
1. Payment requests via phone calls are suspicious
2. Claiming previous payment was "too little" because of VAT is unusual
3. Asking to pay additional fees over the phone is a classic fraud tactic

**What you should do:**
- **DO NOT send any money**
- Hang up on this caller
- Contact Apple directly through their official website if you have legitimate concerns about your purchase
- Report this scam attempt to your local consumer protection agency

**Real Apple refund/chargeback process:**
- Would only go through official channels (website support, authorized retailers)
- Never requires upfront additional payments via phone
- Would have order numbers and proper documentation

This is a well-documented scam pattern. Please stay safe and don't send the money!
